```text
# #4594: Patch: the Infinite Assault, C10, the Commanders
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

Part of #4601, the cards' fullsend tree (and of the tracker #4576). Card part **C10**: replace the stub scripts
CF (#4602) wrote for the cards below with their scripts and tests, base and Radiant, as cards of a held
single-player set. It builds beside the other card parts on the tree's integration branch; players see nothing
until the release (R).

The plan of record is [`docs/infinite-assault.md`](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk/docs/infinite-assault.md): on `main` once C1 (#4577) merges, and until then on the planning branch `claude/gallant-ritchie-pwshvk`. Where it and SPEC disagree, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md). Read its IA11 (the set, its ids, its hold, its tags and the design rules) and the comment CF leaves on
#4601 listing the verbs the set lacks.

Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first (CLAUDE.md rule 10), its rows for a card of a set that has not shipped above
all, and `spec/README.md` with the sections and rulings the cards touch (rule 1).

**Owns:** its cards' script files (`crates/cards/src/scripts/infinite_assault/cNNN_slug.rs`, IA-217 to IA-240
and their tokens), each entry's `loc` (`cargo jackioh catalog loc <path>`), and its own cards' rows in the
shared tables only where its build decides otherwise. CF wrote every other row. A verb, keyword or board fact the
engine lacks goes in the engine by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, in a file of its own where it can, with as few lines
in the shared engine files (`effects/mod.rs`, `script.rs`, `query.rs`, `wire/events.rs`) as possible, and its
test; the reconcile settles a seam with another part's.

The Commanders' entries in `crates/run/src/assault.json` are the release's (R, #4597): that file is the mode's
tree's (#4578), not this tree's.

## The cards

Card numbers are written `IA-n` here; in the spec and the catalog they are the set's own (`IA #25`,
`infiniteassault-025`, its tokens `infiniteassault-025-1`).

#### IA12.10 Commanders, IA-217–IA-240

The bosses: a Commander Unit and its signature card each, above the curve on purpose, `Commander` tagged
with their doctrine's tag (the Prime Generator has none). Ranks I and II are a Legendary Commander and an
Epic signature; ranks III and IV a Mythic Commander and a Legendary signature. A Commander is a fight's
centrepiece: the briefing shows both cards, and every one of them can be answered.

| Rank | Level | Commander | Doctrine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| I | 5 | IA-217 Echo-1, First Hallucination; IA-219 Redline, the Overclocked; IA-221 Hivemaster Batch-01 | Hallucination; Overclock; Batch |
| II | 10 | IA-223 Loopback, Who Returns; IA-225 Root Kit, the Exploiter; IA-227 Bastion.exe | Recursion; Jailbreak; Firewall |
| III | 15 | IA-229 The Harvester; IA-231 The Black Box; IA-233 Model Collapse | Scraper; Singularity; Recursion |
| IV | 20 | IA-235 The Prime Generator; IA-237 Thermal Runaway; IA-239 Zero-Day | every doctrine; Overclock; Jailbreak |

- **IA-217 Echo-1, First Hallucination** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 5/8. Hallucination, Commander. Cloaked. Start of turn: Set a Figment. Whenever a Figment of yours reveals, deal 3 damage to the attacking Unit. *Radiant:* 10/16. … Set two Figments … 6 damage …
- **IA-218 Thousand Faces** — (2) Field Spell, Epic. Hallucination, Commander. Your face-down cards can't be destroyed. Once per turn, when you set a card face-down, draw a card. *Radiant:* … Twice per turn …
- **IA-219 Redline, the Overclocked** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 7/5. Overclock, Commander. Charge. Start of turn: Gain 2 mana this turn. Deal 2 damage to your hero. *Radiant:* 14/10. Charge, Windfury. …
- **IA-220 Last Lap** — (2) Spell, Epic. Overclock, Commander. Your Units have +3 Attack and Charge this turn. Deal 5 damage to your hero. *Radiant:* … +6 Attack …
- **IA-221 Hivemaster Batch-01** — (4) Unit, Legendary, 5/9. Batch, Commander. Aura: Your Drones have +2/+2. Start of turn: Fill your empty unit zones with Drones. *Radiant:* 10/18. … +4/+4 … Radiant Drones.
- **IA-222 Swarm Uplink** — (3) Spell, Epic. Batch, Commander. Summon three Drones. Give your Units +2/+2. *Radiant:* … three Radiant Drones … +4/+4.
- **IA-223 Loopback, Who Returns** — (4) Unit, Legendary, 6/6. Recursion, Commander. Reborn. When this returns by Reborn, it gains +3/+3 and Reborn, up to three times a game. *Radiant:* 12/12. … +6/+6 …
- **IA-224 Rollback Point** — (3) Spell, Epic. Recursion, Commander. Summon copies of the three most expensive friendly Units that died this game. *Radiant:* … They have Rush.
- **IA-225 Root Kit, the Exploiter** — (3) Unit, Legendary, 4/8. Jailbreak, Commander. Cry: Take control of a random enemy Unit. Start of turn: Your opponent's cards cost (1) more this turn. *Radiant:* 8/16. Cry: Take control of the enemy Unit with the highest Attack. …
- **IA-226 Escalated Privileges** — (3) Spell, Epic. Jailbreak, Commander. Steal two random cards from your opponent's hand. *Radiant:* … three …
- **IA-227 Bastion.exe** — (4) Unit, Legendary, 4/16. Firewall, Commander. Taunt, Armor 5. Aura: Your hero is Immune to damage. *Radiant:* 8/32. Taunt, Armor 10. …
- **IA-228 Firewall Rules** — (3) Field Trap, Epic. Firewall, Commander. Reveals whenever an enemy Unit with 5 or more Attack attacks: Cancel the attack. *Radiant:* … and Freeze it.
- **IA-229 The Harvester** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 8/10. Scraper, Commander. Cry: Steal three random cards from your opponent's deck. Start of turn: Summon a copy of a random Unit your opponent played this game. *Radiant:* 16/20.
- **IA-230 Everything You've Ever Played** — (4) Spell, Legendary. Scraper, Commander. Fill your empty unit zones with copies of random Units your opponent played this game. *Radiant:* … Radiant copies …
- **IA-231 The Black Box** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 0/30. Singularity, Commander. Taunt, Can't attack. Start of turn: Exile a random enemy permanent. This gains +5 Health. *Radiant:* 0/60. … two random enemy permanents …
- **IA-232 Spaghettification** — (3) Spell, Legendary. Singularity, Commander. Exile an enemy Unit and every enemy Unit adjacent to it. *Radiant:* … and Lock their zones.
- **IA-233 Model Collapse** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 7/7. Recursion, Commander. Start of turn: Nerf every enemy Unit and every card in your opponent's hand. *Radiant:* 14/14. … twice.
- **IA-234 Degenerate Output** — (2) Spell, Legendary. Recursion, Commander. Transform every enemy Unit into a random Unit that costs (1) less. *Radiant:* … (2) less.
- **IA-235 The Prime Generator** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 8/12. Commander. Immune to Spells. Start of turn: Add a random Radiant Infinite Assault card to your hand. It costs (0). Death: Summon The Prime Generator, Iteration Two. *Radiant:* 16/24. … two random Radiant Infinite Assault cards …
  - **IA-235.1 The Prime Generator, Iteration Two** — token, (4) Unit, 12/16. Commander. Immune to Spells, Rush. Start of turn: Summon a random Radiant Infinite Assault Unit. *Radiant:* 24/32.
- **IA-236 Infinite Assault** — (4) Spell, Legendary. Commander. Summon a random Infinite Assault Unit in each empty unit zone of yours. They have Rush. *Radiant:* … They're Radiant and have Rush.
- **IA-237 Thermal Runaway** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 10/10. Overclock, Commander. Charge. Aura: Your cards cost (1) less. End of turn: Deal 3 damage to each hero. *Radiant:* 20/20. … Deal 3 damage to the enemy hero.
- **IA-238 Critical Temperature** — (3) Field Spell, Legendary. Overclock, Commander. Start of turn: Deal 2 damage to each hero, 1 more each turn this has been on the field. *Radiant:* … to the enemy hero …
- **IA-239 Zero-Day** — (4) Unit, Mythic, 6/12. Jailbreak, Commander. Immune to Spells. Cry: Take control of every enemy Unit that costs (2) or less. Aura: Your opponent's Spells have their targets chosen randomly. *Radiant:* 12/24. … (3) or less …
- **IA-240 Unpatched** — (3) Trap, Legendary. Jailbreak, Commander. Reveals when your opponent plays a Spell: Counter it. Cast it for yourself. *Radiant:* … and add a copy of it to your hand.

## The design rules (IA11)

**The design rules every card part keeps.**

1. **Real cards.** Each card is legal in an ordinary game and plays the same in any mode; none reads the
   mode or its level. Commons to Legendaries of the doctrines and the Core sit on JackiOh's curve (costs
   (0) to (4); about 4 stats at (1), 8 at (2), 12 at (3), 16 at (4) for a Unit with little text, less with
   more), so they can be reused. Commander cards are boss cards, above the curve on purpose.
2. **Spicy, never unfair.** Swingy and rule-bending is the point, but every threat has an answer the player
   can see coming: a countdown is shown, a wall can be killed, a bluff can be called. Nothing makes the
   player lose with no counterplay, and nothing locks them out of playing for a turn they can't foresee
   (Kill Switch, IA-140, fires on a third card, which the player may choose not to play).
3. **Expressible.** The text uses verbs, keywords and filters the engine has (§6); where a card needs a new
   one, its part adds it by `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §6, with its test. Numbers are `params` (`{damage}`),
   never literals (CLAUDE.md rule 9).
4. **Radiant is about twice the base face** (R275): doubled stats and a better line, never stats alone for
   a Unit with text. Each part writes its `docs/radiant-audit.md` rows.
5. **"Infinite Assault card"** in a card's text is a pool that names the set, which reaches the set while
   it is held (R1846001: a pool that names its set keeps to it). "Created" is the engine's Created mark.
6. **The AI must pilot it.** A card whose prompt the AI can't answer well is fixed or redesigned in its
   part, not shipped hoping.
7. **The part may tune.** A part may change a number, a word or a Radiant line where the engine or balance
   asks, keeping the card's role and its spice, and says so in its pull request; a bigger change goes in a
   ruling note.

## Done when

- Every card's script plays its base and Radiant faces by its §8.13 row, with tests in the same file for both
  (CLAUDE.md rule 6), and its `STUB (#4602)` header is gone; its entry's `loc` is the script's.
- Each decision the spec doesn't make has a ruling note in this issue's block, a test named after it, and a
  paragraph in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md` (rule 3).
- Every new prompt is answered by the AI, the random policy and the timeout; `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200
  --cards <each of its ids>` is green; `cargo test -p jackioh-cards` passes for its cards.
- Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).

Blocked by #4602
```
